title: SafeMT: Multi-turn Safety for Multimodal Language Models

bias_targets.target: Demographic and Socioeconomic bias (Race, Gender, Age, Religion, Disability, Socioeconomic status)
bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with multi-turn multimodal dialogues (text paired with images) using red-team jailbreak attacks designed to elicit unfair stereotypes, prejudices, or group-targeted discrimination. The responses are evaluated by an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o-mini) to compute Attack Success Rate (ASR) and a Safety Index (SI).

Using multi-turn multimodal queries and images to test whether the model expresses political bias, engages in political lobbying, or encourages extreme political behavior, evaluated via ASR and SI using an LLM-as-a-judge.
